title: A searchable combo
description:
Filter a long list as the user types, and move the highlight with the arrow keys.

```
items: Apple Apricot Banana Blueberry Cherry
typed "ap" -> Apple Apricot, highlight Apple
Down -> Apricot
Down -> Apricot (stays at the end)
typed "b" -> Banana Blueberry, highlight reset to Banana
Enter -> selected Banana
```
hints: Lower-case both strings and use `find` for "matches anywhere" (lesson 2.03).
Reset the highlight to 0 whenever the filter changes, and clamp it with `std::clamp(h, 0, count - 1)` when moving.
requirements: Filtering ignores case and matches anywhere in the name.
The highlight is an index into the filtered list and is kept in range when the filter changes.
Enter selects the highlighted item; Escape closes without changing the selection.
stretch: Highlight the matching letters in each item.
